## Changelog

### New features

- Added player data synchronization between the launcher and profiles, including device authentication and a bidirectional synchronization API.
- Added player and device administration, S3-compatible storage configuration, and global player quota management.
- Added synchronization usage reporting and safe storage cleanup tools.
- Added documentation for launcher authentication and the player synchronization API.

### Bug fixes and improvements

- Improved upload validation and error reporting, including required upload headers.
- Made dashboard activity views resilient to stale database activity counters.
- Added automated tests for synchronization APIs, metrics, and storage paths.

## How to upgrade

### First-time setup

Please follow [this guide](https://emlproject.com/docs/eml-admintool/system-requirements) to install EML AdminTool for the first time.

### Upgrading from a previous version

1. Log in to EML AdminTool as administrator.
2. Click on the "Settings" tab.
3. Scroll down to the "Update" section.
4. Click on the "Update" button and wait for the update to complete.

Please note that EML AdminTool will not be available during the update process. We recommend that you perform the update during off-peak hours to minimize disruption to your users.
